findings.exact_correction: Add a transient metrics correlation UUID to the validated inspect result, independent of recovery; preserve existing recovery creation, summaries and directories.
findings.observed_deficiency: Current inspect output builds assignments, loop modes, input-valid flag and installation fingerprints, but no metrics_run_id exists in the inspected source.
findings.violated_requirement: FR-003, FR-010 and T003: one separate metrics correlation identity across probes and modeled turns, independent of recovery identity.

findings.exact_correction: Add the approved fresh-token begin immediately before native dispatch/continuation and finish immediately after an observed ending; retain token through pending acknowledgements/polls and end question turns before human waiting.
findings.observed_deficiency: Current shared protocol directs probes, native spawn, same-child continuation and observation without begin/finish metric calls or retained timing tokens.
findings.violated_requirement: FR-001 and FR-002 / T006: measure native working-turn dispatch and continuation boundaries, exclude human wait and keep pending calls open.

findings.exact_correction: Narrow the prohibition only for metrics metadata before timing: exact-name project TOML matching, model/model_reasoning_effort mapping, null unavailable values, no inherited/global resolution, no dispatch overrides and no runtime-verification claim.
findings.observed_deficiency: Current source says FarmBoy does not parse agent TOML, explicitly prohibits parsing consumer TOML, and permits model/effort claims only when Codex exposes them. No metrics-only file-declared metadata exception exists.
findings.violated_requirement: FR-022 / T008: permit a narrow passive project-agent TOML read for optional file-declared model/effort while preserving native dispatch authority.

T001.description: Create the FarmBoy-only maintainer report source scaffold and declare `openpyxl==3.1.5` plus required `et-xmlfile` in `skills/farmboy-metrics-report/SKILL.md`, `skills/farmboy-metrics-report/agents/openai.yaml`, and `skills/farmboy-metrics-report/requirements.txt`; create and document the local `.agents/skills/farmboy-metrics-report` discovery symlink in `docs/installation.md`; keep the source and dependency outside consumer controller and bundle inventories.

T002.description: Implement importable begin/finish helpers and the version-1 record contract with all twelve required fields at their exact types in `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/metrics.py`, preserving these field constraints from `specs/022-local-workflow-agent-timing-metrics/data-model.md`: `schema_version` “Exactly `1`; booleans are not integers for validation.”; `invocation_id` “Nonempty opaque turn identity; collector produces UUIDs, report does not reinterpret it as a child ID.”; `run_id` “Nonempty opaque metrics correlation identity for one workflow invocation, retained across probes and modeled turns; independent of recovery identity.”; `step_id` “Exact modeled ID; `preflight` for probes.”; `invocation_kind` “`execution`, `continuation`, `retry`, `probe`.”; `agent_name` “Exact supplied native dispatch name.”; `skill_id` “Exact invoking FarmBoy skill ID.”; `workflow_id` “Exact invoking installed FarmBoy workflow ID.”; `project_label` “Known nonpersonal logical identity or `unspecified`; grouping label, not repository identity.”; `started_at` and `finished_at` “Valid UTC timestamp `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`.”; `duration_ms` “Signed difference of timestamp epoch milliseconds; reject booleans, fractions and mismatched arithmetic.”; `model` “Explicit `model` in the uniquely matching project agent TOML file; optional, absent normalizes to null.”; and `effort` “Explicit `model_reasoning_effort` in that file; optional, absent normalizes to null.” Also implement millisecond wall-clock sampling, invocation UUID creation, UTC timestamp formatting, JSON stdin/stdout interface, serialization, and public validation helpers; require a UTF-8 JSON object no larger than 65,536 bytes with no duplicate keys or nonfinite numeric constants, and reject projected strings over 32,767 characters or containing illegal XML characters without trimming or truncation (depends on T005).

T003.description: [P] Add a transient metrics correlation UUID to the validated inspect result in `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/controller.py`; keep it separate from recovery identity and leave recovery creation, summaries, and directories unchanged (depends on T002).

T004.description: [P] Verify `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/metrics.py` is automatically included at its installed path through `controller_package_files`; cover consumer delivery and exclusion of `skills/farmboy-metrics-report/` in `tests/test_catalog.py` and `tests/test_bundle_lifecycle.py`, preserving the ten controller bindings (depends on T002).

T005.description: [P] Add foundational record-contract tests in `tests/test_metrics.py` before implementing the helper: cover all twelve required fields (`schema_version` exactly `1` and booleans are not integers; nonempty opaque `invocation_id` and `run_id`; exact modeled `step_id`; exact `agent_name`, `skill_id`, `workflow_id`, and nonpersonal `project_label`; `started_at` and `finished_at` exactly `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`; signed integer `duration_ms`) and optional nullable `model` and `effort` (absent normalizes to null; present values are null or nonempty strings); cover `invocation_kind` exactly `execution`, `continuation`, `retry`, or `probe`; reject missing/empty strings, booleans or fractions in integer fields, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numeric constants, impossible timestamps, unsupported schema/kind, and mismatched duration arithmetic; verify equal/backward clock readings and the 65,536-byte JSON, 32,767-character and legal-XML-text limits without trimming or truncation against `specs/022-local-workflow-agent-timing-metrics/data-model.md` and `contracts/metric-record.md`.

T006.description: [P] [US1] Add shared protocol instructions for creating a fresh turn token immediately before native dispatch or continuation, retaining it through pending acknowledgements and polls, and finishing it immediately after the observed turn boundary in `controllers/farmboy/controller-protocol.md` (depends on T009).

T007.description: [P] [US1] Read optional `model` and `effort` from project `.codex/agents/*.toml` by exact `name` before timing starts, map `model` and `model_reasoning_effort`, and return null for unavailable or ambiguous settings in `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/metrics.py` (depends on T002 and T009).

T008.description: [US1] Specify probe `step_id=preflight`, exact `execution`/`continuation`/`retry` kinds, metrics run-ID retention across a workflow, known nonpersonal `project_label` fallback to `unspecified`, and the metadata allowlist in `controllers/farmboy/controller-protocol.md`; narrow its blanket TOML prohibition only to permit the passive metrics read of explicit `model` and `model_reasoning_effort` from the exact-name project agent file before timing, while preserving native dispatch/configuration authority, no spawn overrides, no inheritance or global resolution, and no claim of runtime verification; exclude prompts, transcripts, secrets, host paths, tokens, and human-answer waiting (depends on T006 and T009).

T009.description: [US1] Write controller and metrics behavior tests in `tests/test_controller.py` and `tests/test_metrics.py` before implementation; cover probe/execution/continuation/retry boundaries, question/answer timing, pending polls, correlation, exact TOML name matching and unavailable/ambiguous settings, dispatch rejection, and failure or missing-end behavior (depends on T005).

T010.description: [US2] Publish each record through an exclusive hidden temporary file followed by no-clobber hard-link publication as `metric-<invocation-uuid>.json`, then remove only the writer-owned temporary name in `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/metrics.py` (depends on T002 and T012).
